correctness.rationale: The two Toeplitz orders are computed on the stable dense span of Fock kernels, giving the exact q_{a,b} array. A direct finite-character growth lemma proves that a bounded Berezin diagonal forces every nonzero q to satisfy a+b=0. Such terms are explicitly scalar Weyl unitaries. Weyl conjugation and weak escape give the exact essential norm for any finite sum; circular Weyl spectrum gives the sharp two-frequency norm. The proof covers zero coefficients, cancellations, repeated parameters after combining, and distinctness boundaries. checker.py passed 1775 finite assertions but is not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete and natural classification of nonzero bounded harmonic-exponential commutators complements an explicitly studied cancellation-sensitive zero-commutation problem. The theorem handles arbitrarily many finite complex frequencies, establishes exact norm-versus-essential-norm rigidity and gives a sharp quantified nonzero two-frequency family. This is neither an arbitrary finite table nor a routine singleton restatement.
